title.zh: Bend – A language that blocks AI mistakes via proof, on CPU and GPU

current_state.zh: Bend is a new programming language that blocks AI mistakes through formal proofs and runs on both CPUs and GPUs, drawing strong Hacker News discussion about its design and the role of formal verification in AI-assisted coding.
